test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 5 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

An expert in writing by hand
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Chirographer.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **chirographer **is** a person who is skilled in handwriting or calligraphy.**
 
• The term is derived from the Greek words **"cheir" **meaning **hand **and **"grapho"** meaning **to write**.
 
• Therefore, an expert in writing by hand can be described as a **chirographer**.
 
 
• Example: The wedding invitations were beautifully written by a **chirographer**.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Other options:
 
• **Obstetrician - **A doctor who specializes in childbirth and caring for women giving birth.
 
 
• Example: She was under the care of a skilled **obstetrician **during her pregnancy.
 
 
 
• **Funambulist** - A tightrope walker or acrobat who performs on a tightrope.
 
 
• Example: The **funambulist **walked the tightrope without a safety net.
 
 
 
• **Endodontist **- A dentist who specializes in treating the soft inner tissue of teeth.
 
 
• Example: He had to see an **endodontist **for a root canal treatment.
